parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: ExportType
parameters.description:
The type of archive data to export. Valid values:

- **suspiciousExport**: security alerts.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for requests and responses. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Default value: 1.
